title: Aura Canvas Engine
tagline: Real-time collaborative architectural sketchpad powered by WebSockets and CRDTs
description: High-performance vector canvas with infinite zoom, spatial indexing, and sub-millisecond local latency. Backed by an Elixir/Go service hosted on Render that reconciles multi-tenant drafting sessions in real time.

title: Cognitive Query Mesh
tagline: Semantic search and document synthesis pipeline across heterogenous databases
description: An asynchronous vector indexing pipeline that chunks, embeds, and summarizes technical CAD specifications and PDF blueprints using hybrid sparse-dense retrieval. Runs serverless background workers on Render.

title: Telemetry Sentinel
tagline: Edge-compatible distributed tracing & infrastructure health observability daemon
description: Lightweight observability sidecar that aggregates metrics across microservices, auto-detects cold-start delays, and visualizes system latency heatmaps through a minimalist terminal-inspired interface.

title: ChronoDraft Studio
tagline: Parametric layout generator and architectural blueprint compiler
description: Translates high-level natural language constraints into valid SVG blueprints and IFC 3D massing. Features real-time constraint validation and BIM schema export.
